name: YooAnalytics – Privacy Friendly, Alternative to Google Analytics for WordPress and WooCommerce
author: YooAnalytics

sections.description:
YooAnalytics is a privacy friendly analytics plugin for WordPress & WooCommerce, YooAnalytics is alternative to Google Analytics. It helps you to track your visitors, views, online users, search engine referrers, referrers, search engines referrers, WooCommerce purchase events, WooCommerce checkout journey and much more.

📈 Analytics for WordPress & WooCommerce

  • Visitors Tracking
  • Views Tracking
  • Online Users Tracking
  • WooCommerce Purchase Events Tracking
  • Search Engine Referrers Tracking
  • Referrers Tracking
  • Search Engines Referrers Tracking

⌛ Realtime (Coming Soon)

  • Realtime Visitors Tracking

🌍 Countries – Geolocation (Coming Soon)

  • Visitors by Country

🛒 Complete Checkout/ Purchase Journey (Coming Soon)

  • WooCommerce Checkout Journey
  • WooCommerce Purchase Journey

ℹ️ Much More (Coming Soon)
sections.faq:
Where is the data stored?

The data is stored in your WordPress database.

Do I need account?

No.

Is there any limitations with Views, Visitors tracking?

No.

  • FIX 🐛 – Query using current timezone.
  • FIX 🐛 – Font Family was conflicting with some Dashicons.

0.0.1 – Feb 17, 2025

  • Initial Release 🎉
